explanation: A set also has honour tiles for the four winds and three dragons. Mahjong spread from China and became a craze in the United States in the 1920s.

claims.text: Mahjong tiles are divided into suits of dots (also called circles), bamboos and characters.

A mahjong set includes honour tiles for the four winds and the three dragons.
Mahjong spread from China and became a craze in the United States in the 1920s.
